title: Austin Faces Bergstrom Closure
summary:
*   City leaders held a special meeting to discuss the potential closure of Bergstrom Air Force Base.
*   The discussion included insights from the Deputy Assistant Secretary of the Air Force and Congressman J.J. (Jake) Pickle.
*   Council members questioned Air Force officials about the future implications of the base's potential closure.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING - February 21, 1992
TOWN LAKE CENTER - 2:00 P.M.
Mayor Todd called to order the meeting of the Council* noting the absence of Mayor Pro
Tern Urdy and Councilmember Nofziger.
Mayor Todd announced the purpose of the meeting vas to have a discussion of Bergstrom Air
Force Base closure vith James F.
Boatright, Deputy Assistant Secretary of the Air Force (Installations).
After remarks by Congressman J.J. (Jake) Pickle, members of the Council directed
questions, previously submitted, to Secretary Boatright for his response. A copy of the
questions are on file in the City Clerk's office.
At 3:08 P.M., the meeting vas adjourned.
